items.title: Gemini's AI task automation will work with dozens of apps on Galaxy phones
items.excerpt: Google's Gemini Task Automation feature will soon work with 134 apps on select Galaxy phones and tablets running Android 17 or newer.
items.rationale: Gemini's agentic task automation expands to 134 apps on Android 17 Galaxy devices, a concrete scope figure for phone-side AI agents.

items.title: Christian Linux project plans $449 phone with AI-powered Bible study
items.excerpt: Can faith and artificial intelligence come together in a new operating system? Jesus Dash is an ambitious Christian technology project combining Linux, AI-powered assistance, and religious resources. Its founder is also developing a $449 smartphone called PineCone, targeting early 2027. Some applica
items.rationale: A niche Linux phone built around an AI study assistant ($449 PineCone, early 2027) shows AI phones splitting into purpose-built, community-specific devices.

items.title: Samsung’s free Galaxy AI ride might be ending. Get ready to pay $5 for it
items.excerpt: Samsung is reportedly testing a Galaxy AI Premium subscription with a $4.99 monthly plan, new AI video generation and Bixby automation tools, and usage limits that could change how existing free features work.
items.rationale: Reported $4.99/month Galaxy AI Premium tier with usage limits would end the free-AI era on Samsung phones; it changes what buyers pay for on-device AI.

items.title: Your Wear OS watch can now run Meta’s Muse AI agent
items.excerpt: Meta’s Muse AI agent now works on Wear OS smartwatches, reaching Android users' wrists before Meta’s own Charm wearable arrives.
items.rationale: Meta ships its Muse agent to Wear OS watches, a separate platform release after the Apple Watch version, and it arrives before Meta's own Charm wearable.

items.title: Rumored Apple Smart Glasses Mentioned in Supplier's Earnings Briefing
items.excerpt: Apple's rumored smart glasses and AirPods with cameras may have been referenced by Chinese manufacturing equipment supplier Quick Intelligent Equipment, according to a Securities Times report on the company's quarterly earnings briefing.
